title: What If You Could See in Complete Darkness?

shots.line: Blackout. Every light on your street dies at once. You keep walking.
shots.scene: Wide night street, every house lit. On 'Blackout' the lamps and windows die house by house (street power 1->0). Slow push-in, rain-free. HERO silhouette keeps walking along the pavement under the last lamp, unbothered (walkPose), then into the dark.

shots.line: Round the coffee table. Over the shoe.
shots.scene: Top-down diagram of the flat: furniture as dark shapes, HERO's path draws on as a glowing ink line round the coffee table, over the shoe (tiny hop arc). Dotted trajectory, label 'COFFEE TABLE' / 'SHOE' pop on the words.

shots.line: Past the door that always eats your knee.
shots.scene: Macro: the door edge swings in, HERO's knee glides past it by a centimetre, a little 'whoosh' of air; dust puffs. Dry-humour hold on the gap.

shots.line: You find the cat on top of the fridge.
shots.scene: Medium two-shot: HERO beside the fridge looking up; BISCUIT sits on top of the fridge, purple collar, eyes glint in the dark. Slow push. HERO smiles proudly.

shots.line: Biscuit blinks. She looks offended.
shots.scene: Giant close-up of Biscuit's face: green eyeshine, slow blink, then the eyes drop to heavy-lidded 'offended' on 'offended'. Purple collar in frame. Whiskers twitch.
shots.notes: cat head drawn big via cat() with s~5

shots.line: Your little sister Mina stumbles in, torch first.
shots.scene: Doorway: MINA (child scale, red scarf) stumbles in torch-first, phone torch beam swinging, bumps the door. HERO in the foreground smirking, lit by the torch rim. Camera drifts right.

shots.line: How are you doing this? You shrug.
shots.scene: Over-the-shoulder: big blurred HERO shoulder in the foreground, MINA sharp in the torch glow, confused ('how are you doing this?'), talking with ring pulses; HERO shrugs on 'You shrug'.

shots.line: You can see the mouse by the bin. You can see the toast cooling.
shots.scene: THERMAL VIEW (hero's POV): the dark flat in false colour; a mouse glows orange by the bin, then the camera pans to toast on a plate cooling from yellow to purple. Chip 'Mouse. Toast. No charger.' HUD brackets.

shots.line: You still cannot find your phone charger.
shots.scene: Insert: HERO's hands pat the side table, the charger brick is a dead black rectangle in thermal view (cold), cable invisible. Hand glows, charger does not. Sigh, expression sad.

shots.line: What if you could see in complete darkness?
shots.scene: TITLE CARD over a black frame that fades up into the night skyline: 'WHAT IF YOU COULD SEE IN COMPLETE DARKNESS?' with slow warm glow and stars. Flash in.

shots.line: Rule one... your eyes quit first.
shots.scene: RULE 1 title card: 'RULE 1 / YOUR EYES QUIT FIRST' over the dark cinema hall, projector beam and dust.

shots.line: A human eye holds about one hundred and twenty million rods. Rods handle the dark.
shots.scene: Blueprint: the eye cross-section draws on, light rays enter; rods highlighted in the retina. Chip 'About 120 million rods' on the number.

shots.line: It also holds about six million cones.
shots.scene: Blueprint: retina inset swaps to cones (triangles, red/green/blue) filling in. Chip 'About 6 million cones'.

shots.line: Cones handle colour. And at night, they clock out.
shots.scene: Gag: a rainbow poster on the cinema wall; cones as tiny workers punch out at a time clock one by one as the colour drains to grey. Dry humour.

shots.line: Walk from sunshine into a cinema. You are blind.
shots.scene: Wide: a blazing white doorway at left; HERO and DEV silhouettes step into the black hall and stop, blind. Doorway light shrinks as the door closes. Slow push.

shots.line: Your rods need twenty to thirty minutes to catch up.
shots.scene: Data: giant clock face sweeps 20 to 30 minutes over the dark hall, rods icon refilling like a battery. Chip 'Rods: 20-30 minutes'.

shots.line: Dev shuffles in beside you, orange beanie first, popcorn flying.
shots.scene: Medium two-shot in the hall: DEV (orange beanie) shuffles in beside HERO, popcorn flying in slow arcs, rim from the screen. Dev stumbles; HERO stands steady.

shots.line: Where is row F? he groans. You walk straight to it.
shots.scene: Medium: DEV groans 'Where is row F?' squinting at nothing. Row F sign glows in the foreground blur; then HERO walks straight to it, confident, Dev bumping seats behind. Camera tracks with them.

shots.line: A cat needs roughly a sixth of the light you do.
shots.scene: Giant close-up of Biscuit: huge eyeshine pupils contracting; chip 'Cat: about 1/6 the light'.

shots.line: You? None. But even a cat is blind in true darkness.
shots.scene: Medium: HERO sits calm on the sofa in the pitch dark, a big floating '0' chip; Biscuit tries to cross the room and bonks into the wall ('even a cat is blind in true darkness').

shots.line: Humans are not hopeless, though. In a 2016 experiment,
shots.scene: Lab in near dark: a row of volunteers (plain grey figures) sit with notepads, an eye-chart glow at the far end. Slow push. Chip 'Nature Comms, 2016'.

shots.line: volunteers spotted single photons better than chance. One photon. One.
shots.scene: Blueprint: a single glowing photon travels from the left into the eye and hits the retina with a ripple; big gold '1' counts up. 'One photon. One.'

shots.line: Upside, no more stubbed toes.
shots.scene: Insert: HERO's bare foot slides past the coffee-table leg with a little checkmark sparkle. Thumbs-up. Quick.

shots.line: Downside, Dev wants to know why you keep staring at him. Fair question.
shots.scene: Two-shot: DEV leans away from HERO (hold for 'Fair question': slow push on Dev squinting), hugging the popcorn bucket, suspicious sideways look; HERO keeps staring (eyes wide).

shots.line: So how do you see where nothing shines?
shots.scene: Medium: HERO alone in the dark row, looking around the hall, head slowly turning, eyes searching. Projector dust.

shots.line: Simple... nothing has to shine.
shots.scene: Giant face of HERO: eyes widen (awe) as a faint warm glow reflects in them. Slow push-in.

shots.line: Everything is already glowing.
shots.scene: FREEZE-FRAME with a flash: the whole cinema blooms into thermal colours - Dev, popcorn, seats glowing in the palette, particles hanging in the air, 'THERMAL' badge in the corner.

shots.line: Rule two... dark isn't empty.
shots.scene: RULE 2 title card: 'RULE 2 / DARK ISN'T EMPTY' over the blacked-out apartment, a faint thermal glow breathing behind the letters.

shots.line: Anything above absolute zero glows with infrared.
shots.scene: Blueprint: infrared wavy lines radiate from a sun-warm cup, a rock and a body, gold label 'INFRARED'. Chip 'Everything warm glows'.

shots.line: Your couch. Your cat. You.
shots.scene: THERMAL VIEW of the flat: couch faint purple, Biscuit orange, HERO white-hot, each labelled as spoken ('COUCH' 'CAT' 'YOU') by wordTime. Slow push.

shots.line: Dr. Lin, in her green lanyard, kills every light in the lab.
shots.scene: Lab wide: DR LIN (white coat, green lanyard) at the light switch, ceiling strips die in a ripple, the room drops to blueprint-wall glow + exit light. HERO nearby, tiny.

shots.line: She holds up one hand. You count five warm fingers.
shots.scene: THERMAL insert: one hand held up, five fingers glow yellow-white, counted off with tiny gold numbers 1-5 on the words 'five warm fingers'.

shots.line: She is not scared. She is thrilled.
shots.scene: Giant face of DR LIN in the dark, lit by blueprint-wall glow: grinning, glasses glinting, thrilled. Slow push.

shots.line: This is thermal vision, she whispers. Not magic. Physics.
shots.scene: Two-shot: LIN whispering to HERO in the glow, HERO leaning in. At 'Physics' chip 'Not magic. Physics.'

shots.line: Human skin glows most strongly near nine and a half micrometres.
shots.scene: Blueprint: wavelength chart draws on, curve peaks at 9.5 um with a gold marker. Chip 'Skin peak: ~9.5 micrometres'.

shots.line: That is long-wave infrared. Thermal cameras read exactly that band.
shots.scene: Insert: LIN's thermal camera on its tripod, its little screen showing HERO in the false-colour palette; band label 'LONG-WAVE INFRARED'. Rack-focus to the screen.

shots.line: Your own eyes can't. One reason? They are warm too.
shots.scene: Blueprint: eye cross-section where the retina is washed with the eye's own orange glow (glowK), gold label 'EYES ARE WARM TOO'.

shots.line: It's like reading a dim screen with a torch in your face.
shots.scene: Gag: HERO squints at a dim phone screen while a torch points straight into his own face. Washed-out, he winces. Dry humour.

shots.line: Nature found a workaround. Pit vipers have a hollow pit on their face.
shots.scene: Macro: a pit viper's head in the dark undergrowth, the pit organ circled in gold on 'hollow pit'. Rain drips. Slow push.

shots.line: It works like a pinhole camera for heat.
shots.scene: THERMAL snake's-eye POV: a circular pinhole vignette, a warm mouse blurred as a heat blob that sharpens through the pinhole. Label 'PINHOLE CAMERA FOR HEAT'.

shots.line: Its nerves use a heat-sensitive protein called TRPA1.
shots.scene: Blueprint: a nerve ending with the TRPA1 channel as a gate; heat arrows open it. Gold label 'TRPA1'.

shots.line: Scientists pinned that down in 2010.
shots.scene: Data card: 'TRPA1, Nature 2010' with an animated journal-page stamp. Navy card over the blueprint grid.

shots.line: A snake finds a mouse in total darkness.
shots.scene: THERMAL medium: viper coiled, a mouse glows and darts; the viper lunges and strikes in one beat. Rain static in the cold layer.

shots.line: You? The mouse... and the remote.
shots.scene: HERO on the sofa, lifts the TV remote which glows warm in his thermal view (cut to normal view, remote in his hand), triumphant, Biscuit watching.

shots.line: Out on the dark street, you spot a kitten under a parked car.
shots.scene: THERMAL wide of the dark street (power 0): a small orange glow under a parked car; HERO and DEV walk in, HERO points. Slow push.

shots.line: A small orange glow. You rescue it.
shots.scene: Insert: HERO kneels on the kerb, cups a tiny kitten (warm, in his hands), warm light on his face. Expression: tender smile. Normal view, soft rim.

shots.line: Then you walk face first into a shop window.
shots.scene: Medium two-shot: HERO strides confidently with DEV beside him, bonks flat face-first into the invisible shop window. Dev flinches.

shots.line: Ordinary glass blocks thermal infrared.
shots.scene: THERMAL: the shop window is a flat cold purple slab while the warm people in the shop wall are invisible; HERO's heat bounces back as a faint reflection. Chip 'Glass blocks thermal infrared'.

shots.line: To you, it is a flat, cold wall.
shots.scene: FREEZE-FRAME: HERO's face pressed flat against the glass, cheeks squished, particles hanging, 'COLD WALL' label.

shots.line: Dev wheezes with laughter. Mate... that was a window.
shots.scene: Two-shot: DEV doubled over laughing, wheezing; HERO rubs his nose. 'Mate... that was a window.'

shots.line: Ten out of ten.
shots.scene: Data: a big gold stamp '10/10' slaps down over HERO's squished face freeze; confetti sparkle. Dry humour.

shots.line: Rule three... heat has no colour.
shots.scene: RULE 3 title card: 'RULE 3 / HEAT HAS NO COLOUR' over a thermal-palette gradient wash with the cream title.

shots.line: Mina slides a birthday card across the table.
shots.scene: Medium two-shot at the coffee table: MINA slides a birthday card across, red scarf swaying, HERO leaning in. Torch on the table.

shots.line: In the dark, it is a blank, warm rectangle.
shots.scene: THERMAL insert: the card is a blank warm rectangle, perfectly even yellow, the ink invisible; fingers hover above.

shots.line: Ink and paper sit at the same temperature. No contrast. No words.
shots.scene: Blueprint: two thermometers (INK, PAPER) at the same level, equals sign. Chip 'Same temperature, no contrast'.

shots.line: You guess happy birthday.
shots.scene: Giant face of HERO, confidently guessing, big proud smile.

shots.line: It says get well soon.
shots.scene: Insert in torchlight: the card reads GET WELL SOON in rainbow letters, HERO's hand freezes, smile drops.

shots.line: She tucks a hand warmer into your hoodie pocket. Keep it, she says.
shots.scene: Two-shot: MINA tucks a hand warmer into HERO's hoodie pocket, pats it. 'Keep it, I have the twin.' MINA smiles up.

shots.line: I have the twin. In your sight, it burns like a coal.
shots.scene: THERMAL insert: the hand warmer in HERO's pocket burns white-hot like a coal; Mina's twin glows white-hot in her own pocket, a bright spark pair. PLANT for the payoff.

shots.line: Night-vision goggles work differently.
shots.scene: Insert: a pair of night-vision goggles on a bench, green lenses faintly glowing, dust in the beam.

shots.line: They amplify the faint light already there.
shots.scene: Blueprint: goggle tube diagram, faint starlight in, amplified green image out; gold labels AMPLIFIER.

shots.line: Starlight. Moonlight. In true darkness? Nothing to amplify.
shots.scene: Night sky over the forest: stars and moon, a goggle-green vignette that fades to black as the light drains away; chip 'No light, nothing to amplify'.

shots.line: So thermal wins the pitch black... but only for warm things.
shots.scene: Top-down thermal map of the flat: warm things (cat, mug, HERO) lit in the palette, cold things (shoe, charger, sofa) flat grey.

shots.line: Colour is a bigger ask.
shots.scene: Giant face of HERO, squinting at a grey world, brows up, 'what colour?'

shots.line: Helmet geckos told blue from grey at moonlight levels in 2004. You?
shots.scene: Macro: a helmet gecko on a rock in moonlight; two swatches (blue, grey) are picked out correctly. Chip 'Gecko colour vision, 2004'.

shots.line: Hot, warm, cold. That is your entire palette.
shots.scene: Blueprint: the hero's whole palette as three swatches HOT, WARM, COLD that slide in on the words 'hot', 'warm', 'cold'.

shots.line: Upside, you win hide and seek forever.
shots.scene: THERMAL medium: DEV hides behind the curtain, glowing like a lantern; HERO points straight at him. 'Hide and seek forever.'

shots.line: Downside, you can't read a menu.
shots.scene: Medium: HERO squints at the blank, dim concession menu board, Dev waiting with a wallet. Cold blank slab on the menu.

shots.line: Rule four... light is the enemy.
shots.scene: RULE 4 title card: 'RULE 4 / LIGHT IS THE ENEMY' over the dark street, a single lamp flaring behind the title.

shots.line: You step off the kerb at midnight.
shots.scene: Wide: HERO and DEV at the kerb at midnight, a clock tower reads 12:00 above, empty road. Slow push.

shots.line: A cyclist, no lamp, glows like a ghost.
shots.scene: THERMAL: a cyclist with no lamp glides down the road like a white-orange ghost, bike frame faint purple, tyres cold. Camera pans with them.

shots.line: You yank Dev back. Saved him.
shots.scene: Medium: HERO grabs DEV's sleeve and yanks him back; the cyclist whips past in the road. Hat flies.

shots.line: Dev stares at you. How did you see that?
shots.scene: Giant face of DEV, wide-eyed, 'How did you see that?'

shots.line: Then the cyclist's lamp snaps on.
shots.scene: Insert: the bike lamp snaps on, a hard white-yellow starburst, lens streak, flash.

shots.line: It is one bright flash. Your thermal view whites out.
shots.scene: THERMAL view blooms from palette colours to total white (whiteOut) over the street. Corner readout glitches.

shots.line: Your old eyes are not ready either. Total blindness.
shots.scene: Giant face of HERO: pupils shrink, squeeze shut, the frame whites out then drops to black. Total blindness.

shots.line: Bright light floods your rods. They need twenty to thirty minutes to recover.
shots.scene: Blueprint: retina inset with rods flooding white-hot; recovery bar creeping. Chip 'Recovery: 20-30 minutes'.

shots.line: Your new sight takes about a minute. A long, shaky minute.
shots.scene: Medium: HERO stands blind, hands out, a 60-second stopwatch ring ticking in the corner. A long, shaky minute.

shots.line: Dev guides you home by the sleeve.
shots.scene: Over the shoulder: DEV leads HERO by the sleeve, HERO eyes shut, lamp light blurred in the foreground.

shots.line: Amazing. And awful. Usually both at once.
shots.scene: Wide: the two figures walk home down the long street, lamps flicker on in order, camera slowly pulls back.

shots.line: So the rule is simple. Dark is your friend.
shots.scene: Medium: HERO and MINA in the dark flat, HERO's hand on the light switch, off. Moonlight, calm.

shots.line: Light is a punch. Remember that...
shots.scene: FREEZE-FRAME: the lamp bulb flares to full glare, white-hot starburst, particles hanging; HERO flinches.

shots.line: because you are about to need it.
shots.scene: Giant face of HERO, ominous, slow push, eyes fixed off camera. Music turns tense.

shots.line: Rule five... cold hides.
shots.scene: RULE 5 title card: 'RULE 5 / COLD HIDES' over rainy pines, rain streaks across the letters.

shots.line: A school camping trip. Rain on the trees. Mina is gone.
shots.scene: Wide rainy campsite: two tents, HERO, DEV, MINA (red scarf), RANGER TOMAS (blue cap) huddled, lantern glow. Heavy rain. On 'Mina is gone' push to the empty tent and FREEZE: rain hangs in the air.

shots.line: You scan the forest. Deer. A fox.
shots.scene: THERMAL forest sweep: a deer and a fox glow orange between the black trunks, rain streaks cold. Camera pans left to right.

shots.line: Dev, glowing beside you. Everything alive shows up.
shots.scene: THERMAL two-shot: DEV glows white-hot beside HERO. 'Everything alive shows up.'

shots.line: Except her. Why?
shots.scene: Giant face of HERO, searching, eyes darting. 'Except her. Why?'

shots.line: Rain has soaked everything cold. Warm and cool fade to the same grey.
shots.scene: Blueprint: a thermal scene whose contrast slowly drains to flat grey; two thermometers converging. Chip 'Wet = same temperature'.

shots.line: So where is she? Ranger Tomas, in his blue cap, shouts that it is hopeless.
shots.scene: Medium: RANGER TOMAS shouts over the rain that it is hopeless, waving his arms; HERO silent beside him looking around.

shots.line: You find a cave mouth.
shots.scene: Wide: a cave mouth in the rock, everything grey; HERO approaches slowly. Slow push.

shots.line: Mina's coat is zipped, her skin cool, her body blending into the rock.
shots.scene: THERMAL insert: a curled shape against the cave rock, barely a shade warmer than the stone, Mina's scarf the faintest smear.

shots.line: Almost enough. Not quite.
shots.scene: Giant face of HERO squinting hard. 'Almost enough. Not quite.'

shots.line: Tomas swings his torch at the cave.
shots.scene: Over the shoulder: TOMAS swings his torch beam toward the cave, a blast of white light across HERO's shoulder.

shots.line: Light slams into your eyes. Everything goes white.
shots.scene: FREEZE-FRAME: white flash across the frame, HERO's silhouette recoiling, everything blown out.

shots.line: You are blind... again. Time is short.
shots.scene: Giant face of HERO, eyes squeezed shut, rim white. Dark and still.

shots.line: Mina is cold, and you are blind. Run in blind...
shots.scene: Wide-ish two-shot: HERO, DEV, TOMAS in a tight worried line facing the cave. Decision beat.

shots.line: or wait in the dark? Lights out, you croak. Everybody.
shots.scene: Big line over blurred forest: 'RUN BLIND... OR WAIT?' Chip 'Run blind or wait?'

shots.line: Tomas clicks off his torch.
shots.scene: Two-shot: TOMAS clicks his torch off - the beam snaps out and the forest drops back to blue-black.

shots.line: You count sixty seconds in the dark.
shots.scene: Data: a 60-second countdown ring on near-black, tiny rain, chip 'Sixty seconds'.

shots.line: Then it comes back. Grey rock. Grey rain.
shots.scene: THERMAL wide, grey rock, grey rain, everything the same flat grey as the thermal view slowly returns.

shots.line: And one tiny white spark, as a small hand pulls it from a coat.
shots.scene: THERMAL insert: a small hand pulls the twin hand warmer from a coat; one tiny white spark in the grey. PAYOFF.

shots.line: Mina's hand warmer. The twin.
shots.scene: Giant face of HERO: realisation, awe, tears of relief, spark reflected in his eyes.

shots.line: You reach her, curled under a rock ledge.
shots.scene: Two-shot: HERO crouches under a rock ledge reaching MINA, curled up in her coat, red scarf. Embrace.

shots.line: She is cold. She is smiling.
shots.scene: Giant face of MINA, cold-tinted but smiling, sleepy.

shots.line: You found me, she mumbles. Of course you did.
shots.scene: Two-shot: MINA mumbles 'You found me', HERO holds her, 'Of course you did.' Warm rim.

shots.line: Dev cheers. Tomas wipes his eyes and blames the rain.
shots.scene: Medium: DEV cheers, arms up; TOMAS wipes his eyes and blames the rain.

shots.line: Mina waves the little brick. Best twin ever... and you owe me hot chocolate.
shots.scene: Two-shot: MINA holds up the brick - 'Best twin ever, you owe me hot chocolate' - HERO grins. End on a slow push into the spark.

shots.line: So... is any of this real?
shots.scene: Big line 'IS ANY OF THIS REAL?' in gold over the lab, LIN silhouetted at the blueprint wall.

shots.line: Pit vipers are. Thermal cameras are.
shots.scene: Blueprint icons draw on and tick: pit viper, thermal camera. Gold ticks on the words.

shots.line: Night-vision goggles are. Even single photons are, barely.
shots.scene: Data: icons of goggles and an eye get ticked; chip 'Real: all four'.

shots.line: But no human can see heat.
shots.scene: Giant face of HERO looking at his own hand, no glow. Chip 'No human can see heat'.

shots.line: Goggles are not eyes.
shots.scene: Insert: night-vision goggles on a bench, their screens blank.

shots.line: And without any light, cats and goggles are blind.
shots.scene: Blueprint: goggles and a cat both showing blank black screens. 'Cats and goggles are blind.'

shots.line: Your power would need infrared sensors, and a body that doesn't glow itself.
shots.scene: Medium: LIN beside the blueprint wall pointing out an infrared sensor beside a glowing body; HERO nods. Wall draws on.

shots.line: Are we close? Not yet.
shots.scene: Data: big line 'NOT CLOSE. NOT YET.' with a small progress bar stuck near the left.

shots.line: The dark was never empty. It was only quiet.
shots.scene: Wide: the quiet night street, HERO alone, lamps off, slow pull back; stars appear. Music resolves.

shots.line: So what would you do... if you could see in complete darkness? Tell us in the comments.
shots.scene: Two-shot: HERO and BISCUIT on the sofa look to camera, moonlight, a comment bubble pops. Warm.

shots.line: And if you would trust that tiny white spark...
shots.scene: FREEZE-FRAME: Mina's white spark glowing in the dark, HERO and MINA holding hands in silhouette.

shots.line: hit like, and subscribe for more What Ifs.
shots.scene: End screen: 'WHAT WOULD YOU DO?' with comment bubble, subscribe pill, whole cast lined up.
